description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 21 (Jaffna) - Achchelu (Part) Valikamam East D/S Division, Jaffna District -Block Survey Village Plan No. 71 (North)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically addressing the final settlement of multiple land lots in Jaffna District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels being settled to the State or noted as unclaimed, which falls under land registrations and property ownership matters. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and involves land title settlement procedures, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
